disclosures.text: Spray mist device for depositing dust on falling material flows
Spray mist device for use with belt discharges or chutes
Spray mist device has at least one spray mist unit
Spray mist unit has at least one pressure line connection for a pressure line
Pressure line connects to a fluid supply device
Spray mist unit has at least one nozzle with a nozzle head
Nozzle head has a nozzle outlet
Liquid and/or gaseous fluid is supplied to the nozzle via the pressure line connection
Spray mist device has a frame
Protective curtain is suspended from the frame
Protective curtain is oriented substantially in the direction of falling bulk material
Protective curtain surrounds falling bulk material completely or partially in its circumferential direction
Spray mist unit is built into the protective curtain

Spray mist device for depositing dust on falling material flows, with a spray mist unit having a pressure line connection and a nozzle, and a frame with a suspended protective curtain oriented towards falling bulk material, where the curtai
Protective curtain is made of a flexible, pliable material
Protective curtain forms at least one channel on its outer surface
Channel contains at least one pressure line for fluid supply to the nozzle
Spray mist unit is solely supported by the protective curtain
Undercut is incorporated into the spray mist unit
Nozzle is angled less than 90° to the curtain's orientation
Falling bulk material is sprayable obliquely from above by the nozzle
Nozzle is arranged essentially outside the volume encompassed by the protective curtain
Nozzle head with outlet is within the volume encompassed by the protective curtain
Nozzle outlet is flush with the inner surface of the protective curtain
Nozzle is a mixing nozzle for liquid and gaseous fluid
Spray mist unit has a plurality of nozzles
Nozzles are spaced apart transverse to the curtain's orientation
Nozzles are spaced apart partially along the curtain's longitudinal direction
Frame is a substantially rectangular metal frame
Protective curtain completely surrounds falling bulk material in its circumferential direction
Protective curtain is in the form of a cuboid jacket with four rectangular sides
Spray mist unit has multiple nozzles spaced regularly along one rectangular side of the curtain
Protective curtain comprises multiple lamellar strips
Lamellar strips are suspended lengthwise side-by-side
Lamellar strips are not or not firmly connected to each other
Lamellar strips are oriented in their longitudinal direction towards falling bulk material
Spray mist unit is built into one lamellar strip
Lamellar strips are arranged in first and second rows with a distance between them
Spray mist unit is arranged in the distance between the first and second rows of strips
Spray mist unit is connected to an end of each lamellar strip
Lamellar strips have an outer surface facing away from falling bulk material
Each lamellar strip forms or has at least one channel on its outer surface
Lamellar strips each have a power cable
Power cable is integrated into the lamellar strips
Nozzle has a protective cover for at least partial covering
Protective cover is thermally insulating
Protective curtain has a length of at least 100 cm in the direction of falling bulk material
Lamellar strips each have a length of at least 30 cm
Lamellar strips each have a width of at least 20 cm
